_comment: Committed performance baseline for the two hot paths (issue #31). The gate (perf/scripts/gate.mjs, run by .github/workflows/perf.yml) fails if a run's p95 exceeds baseline p95 * regression_factor, or its error rate exceeds max_error_rate. Regenerate with perf/scripts/capture.mjs (or the 'Perf — capture baseline' workflow) and commit the result. Numbers must be re-captured in the environment the gate runs in — see perf/baseline.md.

capture.environment: local dev — Docker Desktop (Postgres 16 + Mailpit), backend via spring-boot:run, JDK 21
